name: DatePicker
description: Single-date and date-span fields opening a calendar sheet (DatePickerDialog with month/year stepper) in a dialog or a popover, wired into the form system.

fields.mode: PromptMode? - dialog or popover presentation; null = dialog
fields.initialView: CalendarView? - month the calendar opens on; null = value/current month
fields.initialViewType: CalendarViewType? - grid shown first; null = date

notes: The form component dep from the batch plan is consumed as the form_core primitive (ObjectFormField/PromptMode, single owner); no form-component import was needed.
The old dual-pane range layout (two grids side by side above 500px) is deleted; one grid selects a range.
Tapping a month drills into its days and tapping a year into its months (single mode); the header title cycles date/month/year.
DateTimeRange carries no copyWith/toString (file budget); construct directly.
